standard.summary: 动态精度管理：在训练过程中自动切换权重精度（bf16/fp32），非激活状态的权重以低精度存储节省 VRAM，激活时升精度计算。
standard.effect: lulynx_weight_residency 控制常驻 GPU 的权重类型（哪些权重始终保持 GPU 高精度版本）；resource_manager 追踪 VRAM 使用并动态决定精度切换时机。
standard.whenToUse: 大模型（>20GB 基座）在有限显存上训练时的精度管理工具。实验性功能。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足时无需精度动态切换，会增加精度转换开销。

standard_en.summary: Dynamic precision management: switches weight precision (bf16/fp32) automatically during training, keeping inactive weights stored at low precision to save VRAM and raising the precision to compute when they become active.
standard_en.effect: lulynx_weight_residency controls which weight types stay resident on the GPU (which weights always keep a high-precision GPU copy); resource_manager tracks VRAM use and decides dynamically when to switch precision.
standard_en.whenToUse: A precision-management tool for training a large model (>20GB base) on limited VRAM. An experimental feature.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When VRAM is plentiful there is no need for dynamic precision switching, and it adds conversion overhead.

advanced.principle: 权重驻留策略（weight_residency）：LoRA 权重始终高精度（fp32/bf16）驻留 GPU；大基座权重在不激活时降为 fp16/int8 等待卸载，前向时提升为 bf16。resource_log_interval 控制 VRAM 使用日志记录频率。
advanced.tradeoffs: 频繁精度转换会增加 CPU-GPU 数据传输量，对 PCIe 带宽有要求；精度切换过激可能引入累积数值误差。

advanced_en.principle: Weight residency policy (weight_residency): LoRA weights always stay high-precision (fp32/bf16) resident on GPU; large base weights degrade to fp16/int8 while inactive awaiting offload and promote to bf16 at forward. resource_log_interval controls VRAM usage log frequency.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Frequent precision conversions increase CPU-GPU data transfer and demand PCIe bandwidth; overly aggressive switching can introduce cumulative numerical error.
